negative_control.method: Run the identical new assertions against the pinned original sources before any patch, without weakening existing network/privacy guards.
negative_control.expected: Semantic failures on raw warning/url/final_url/exception/cost diagnostic retention; fixture/setup/network failure does not count as RED.

sentinel.kind: Synthetic only; no real applicant or secret.
sentinel.placement: Near the beginning, within current 120-character log prefix; distinct sentinel per case.
sentinel.assertions: No sentinel or full rejected field in formatted text/JSON logs, LogRecord args/extra, exception args/repr, FetchResult fields, AdapterResult errors/outcomes/retry, run/audit/job API-visible diagnostics. Search obvious URL-encoded variants too, without claiming detector coverage of unmatched inputs.

cases.seam: Real offline Fetcher.get with email-bearing synthetic URL and fail-fast cache/DNS/request spies.
required: zero DNS/HTTP/cache-read or body writes after rejection

cases.seam: Real Fetcher redirect loop with MockTransport and stub resolver; safe initial URL redirects to token-bearing hop.
required: initial mocked request counted; hop DNS/request zero
cases.baseline_expected: RED: raw warning and final_url; existing outbound refusal remains GREEN

cases.seam: Actual DiscoveryIntent construction parameterized over email/currency/grade/long number and unsupported population marker.
required: typed field/reason and useful legacy phrase preserved
no rejected value in str/repr/args/diagnostic attributes

cases.seam: Real WebCostAdapter.fetch + offline Fetcher then real runner diagnostic recorders with in-memory run/audit/session spies; expose RunView-equivalent fields using actual view seam if feasible without DB.
required: privacy refusal not queued for retry
fetch-failed reason and safe public origin retained
cases.baseline_expected: RED: original costs_url copied into adapter errors/outcome/retry and runner diagnostics

cases.seam: Inject actual QueryPrivacyError from P3 into actual run_to_decision stage, then actual worker exception branch using memory spies and no SQL/worker process.
required: no sentinel in text/JSON traceback, run.errors, audit.error, JobStore.fail captured argument
job lease token still passed; stale lease behavior unchanged
cases.baseline_expected: RED only when injected typed exception escapes; current discovery catches are not asserted to leak

cases.seam: Normal university URL/CMS numeric path/public query plus mock 404 and existing safe Mathematics after rejected field.
required: actual 404 status and HTTP reason preserved
safe requested field still matchable and attributed
no missing requirement inferred from refused/unknown
cases.baseline_expected: GREEN control; changed-source regression would reject the patch

allowed_future_harness: Owned source copy + existing dependencies read-only; MockTransport/stub DNS/fail-fast socket guard; temporary cache and memory sinks only. Tests/DB/provider have not been run in this design task.
release_gate: Source pin before/after, meaningful OFF semantic RED, exact changed-source GREEN, targeted existing guard/multifield/diagnostic/lease tests; broader validation belongs to root authorized next task.
